news.headline: Say Cheese! A Smiley Face Spotted in Space
news.body: NASA shared a Hubble Space Telescope picture of a galaxy cluster that looks like a giant smiling face. Two bright orange galaxies make the eyes, a white galaxy makes the nose, and curved streaks of light make the smile. Those streaks happen because the cluster is so heavy it bends and stretches light from galaxies behind it, like a magnifying glass. The smiley face is about 4.5 billion light-years away from Earth!

news.headline: Divers Find the World's Oldest Known Shipwreck Cargo
news.body: Underwater archaeologists off the coast of Turkey found the remains of a cargo ship from the Bronze Age, about 4,500 years ago, around when Egypt's Great Pyramid was being built. The wooden ship is long gone, but divers found about 30 big clay storage jars and three huge stone anchors on the seafloor. Some jars still have a shiny goo inside! Scientists are now testing it to learn if the ship carried olive oil, wine, or tree sap.

news.headline: A Team Heads to Antarctica to Fix a Penguin-Filled Base
news.body: An eight-person team, including a carpenter and a mail carrier, will spend five months fixing up an old British research base on Goudier Island in Antarctica. The island is about the size of a soccer field, and they will share it with around a thousand gentoo penguins! Before leaving, the team even took lessons about penguins so they can be good neighbors. One team member will run the world's southernmost post office.

fun_fact: Gentoo penguins are the fastest swimmers of all penguins. They can zoom through the water at about 22 miles per hour! 🐧
